scope.audit: Inputs/hashes, saved forecasts/losses, residual identity, OOF exclusions, metric objective and complete computation dependencies independently reconstructed without forecasting refits. Recorded validation grid and chosen minimum checked, but individual trial fits not independently refitted.
scope.failures: Prespecified baseline fallbacks count as predictions with incurred cost. A missing task makes affected full-roster means and complete-repetition intervals undefined; no matched-success replacement.
scope.metric: Training-only kernel-regression proxy shared by all four gates; optimizing it is not end-to-end KAHM learning or test improvement evidence.
scope.natural: Descriptive equal-collection mean of equal-series means on four selected new collections and twelve series. No domain-population confidence interval; no claims of independent windows or broad superiority.
scope.synthetic: 18 Bonferroni paired Student contrasts over 12 complete independent repetitions per law; normal-difference approximation. No family claim spanning older studies.
scope.timing: Warm component sums, including required baseline/OOF/metric/geometry/head selection, test prediction and retained-model serialization. Shared components charged once per standalone procedure. Imports, source download, preparation, artifact writes and reporting excluded. Geometry transforms of test inputs are conservatively charged even when gamma=0; no test outcomes enter selection.
